column1: # Shell fact counters (Bash, POSIX sh, ksh93): one per line, label TAB pattern (Java regex), counted
# over the whole file. The [ignore] lines run first: they blank comment lines and heredoc bodies (keeping
# the line breaks), so a function or a "set -e" quoted for a remote shell does not count as this
# script's. Counts are regex heuristics: a function defined inside a string, or an option arm written
# on one line with others, is not seen. ShellFactPatternsTest pins every case.
